title: Claude Haiku 5.5 / low effort
description: A white pelican with a long two-part yellow beak, a round orange throat pouch, gray blade-like wings, and orange legs riding a red bicycle with silver spokes over a gray checkered floor; box-shaped shadow artifacts spread across the ground from several angles.

unmetRequirements.evidence: Level views 04-06 and raised view 02 show large dark rectangular shadow slabs far wider than the rider and bicycle, with striped banding inside them. map() (lines 128-131) returns the bounding boxes themselves as distances outside their margin, and the bike box (center y 0.4, half-height 0.42) dips below the ground plane; softSh() (lines 140-149) and ao() march that proxy, so the boxes cast shadows.

warnings: Body, neck, legs and pouch show contour-ring banding in the initial and close views (most visible in close-02).
The eye and pupil are placed only at +z (lines 92-93), so the head has no eye from the left side (level-04 and level-05).
